Stake and contact-info management for shred destinations and leader schedules.

# Purpose
This C file implements the stake contact information manager used by the validator. It keeps the current stake weights, leader schedule data, and shred destination table in sync across two epoch slots. The code builds and updates `fd_shred_dest_t` and `fd_epoch_leaders_t` objects from stake update messages, and it also tracks the local validator identity so it can be added to or updated in the destination list even when it is not part of the external peer list.

The file defines the main `fd_stake_ci_*` lifecycle and update APIs, including [`fd_stake_ci_new`](<#fd_stake_ci_new>), [`fd_stake_ci_stake_msg_init`](<#fd_stake_ci_stake_msg_init>), [`fd_stake_ci_stake_msg_fini`](<#fd_stake_ci_stake_msg_fini>), [`fd_stake_ci_dest_update`](<#fd_stake_ci_dest_update>), [`fd_stake_ci_dest_remove`](<#fd_stake_ci_dest_remove>), and the slot lookup helpers [`fd_stake_ci_get_sdest_for_slot`](<#fd_stake_ci_get_sdest_for_slot>) and [`fd_stake_ci_get_lsched_for_slot`](<#fd_stake_ci_get_lsched_for_slot>). It also contains helper logic to convert vote stake weights into deduplicated stake weights, sort entries by pubkey or stake, and rebuild shred destination tables when contact data or identity data changes.
